name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 56 - Am 161
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 56b. Calls for the establishment of an EU deportation mechanism making all EU aid conditional on the conclusion of effective return agreements with countries of origin, with financial deductions or sanctions applied to governments for every national they refuse to accept in less than three weeks; supports Member States in concluding agreements enabling the full outsourcing of the asylum process to reception centres in safe third countries;
